dedupe_keys.name: lomnicky stit neutron monitor measurements 1981 to 2023 zenodo

description: This Zenodo dataset holds the continuous measurements of the neutron monitor at Lomnický štít (LMKS) in Slovakia, operated by the Institute of Experimental Physics of the Slovak Academy of Sciences: hourly values from December 1981 to July 2023 and minute values from January 2001 to July 2023, in two CSV files. It was published on 6 March 2024 by the institute with nine named authors, and the record gives the CC BY 4.0 licence. Access is free and open by download from Zenodo. Caveats: the series ends in July 2023 in this version, and the record gives no documentation of corrections beyond the description. Coverage is a single high-altitude station, with value for global space weather studies. It supports hazard exposure analysis of solar particle events for aviation radiation, satellites and power grids; related records are SCiESMEX of Mexico and the LAMP Argentine space weather laboratory data.
